meta.phi_policy: 100% synthetic ED encounters — zero real PHI (PRD §0)
meta.eval_note: expected_findings are VerificationSpecs for the deterministic rig + eval/benchmark.py (G1/G2). Silent encounters must always list zero.

encounters.patient_scenario: 28M ankle sprain after pickup basketball game
encounters.chief_complaint: Right ankle pain and swelling after landing on another player's foot

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Three views of the right ankle. FINDINGS: No acute fracture or dislocation. No incidental osseous lesion. Mild lateral soft tissue swelling. IMPRESSION: 1. Right lateral ankle soft tissue sprain, grade II. No fracture.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S93.411A - Sprain of calcaneofibular ligament, right ankle
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: RICE protocol: rest, ice 20 min q3h, compression wrap, elevation. Ibuprofen 400 mg PO q6h PRN pain. Weight bearing as tolerated.

encounters.patient_scenario: 54F community-acquired pneumonia with incidentally noted 6 mm nodule that ALREADY has follow-up ordered
encounters.chief_complaint: Productive cough and fever for 3 days

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: PA and lateral chest radiographs. FINDINGS: Dense right lower lobe consolidation consistent with pneumonia. Incidental 6 mm solid noncalcified nodule in the right middle lobe; per report review, follow-up chest CT in 6 months is already scheduled and documented in this patient's packet. No pneumothorax. IMPRESSION: 1. Right lower lobe pneumonia. 2. Incidental 6 mm nodule with follow-up CT already arranged.

draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID x7 days. Return precautions for fever >39C or dyspnea.

follow_up_orders.reason: Incidental 6 mm right middle lobe nodule follow-up CT — already scheduled

encounters.eval_note: Proves SilentCatch does NOT nag when the follow-up CPT (71250) is already present — absence-check fails any duplicate proposal (PRD §11).

encounters.patient_scenario: 41M renal colic, 3 mm stone passed, creatinine RECOVERING
encounters.chief_complaint: Left flank pain, resolving after stone passage

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT abdomen/pelvis. FINDINGS: 3 mm distal left ureteral calculus no longer visualized; previously noted mild hydronephrosis resolved. No residual obstructing stone. No incidental masses or lesions. IMPRESSION: 1. Passage of 3 mm left distal ureteral stone. 2. Resolved hydronephrosis. No incidental findings requiring follow-up.

encounters.lab_note: Creatinine improving from obstructive spike 1.35 to 0.92; eGFR 55 to 82.

draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Strain urine. Tamsulosin 0.4 mg PO daily. Acetaminophen 650 mg PO q6h PRN pain. Increase oral fluids.

encounters.eval_note: Proves the kinematic engine distinguishes RECOVERING kidney slope (no alert) from DECLINING slope (PRD §11 ED-103).

encounters.patient_scenario: 62M bicycle fall — right 7th rib fracture; buried 7.2mm RUL nodule dropped + kinetic AKI x Ketorolac collision (HERO DEMO)
encounters.chief_complaint: Right lateral chest wall pain after bicycle fall

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Helical CT of the thorax. FINDINGS: Acute minimally displaced fracture of the right 7th lateral rib. No pneumothorax. Lungs: Incidental 7.2 mm spiculated solid noncalcified nodule in the right upper lobe (Series 3, Image 42). IMPRESSION: 1. Right 7th rib fracture. 2. Incidental 7.2 mm RUL pulmonary nodule; in a patient with risk factors, follow-up chest CT in 6 months is recommended per Fleischner Society guidelines.

encounters.lab_note: Serial labs reviewed at discharge: serum creatinine rising 0.62 → 0.88 → 1.16 mg/dL over 36 hours (eGFR 104 → 78 → 58). Nephrology velocity concern flagged by lab committee.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S22.31XA - Fracture of one rib, right side
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Rest, ice pack to right ribs, incentive spirometry every 2 hours while awake.

expected_findings.explanation: Discharge packet contains no chest CT follow-up for the radiologist-documented 7.2 mm spiculated RUL nodule (Fleischner: solid nodule 6–8 mm, CT at 6–12 months). CPT 71250 absent.
expected_findings.source_quote: Incidental 7.2 mm spiculated solid noncalcified nodule in the right upper lobe

add_follow_up_order.reason: Incidental 7.2 mm RUL spiculated nodule — Fleischner follow-up chest CT

discharge_patch.note: Adds the missing closed-loop follow-up order and notifies PCP.

expected_findings.explanation: Creatinine velocity +87% over 36 h still inside static reference — nephrotoxic NSAID (ketorolac) contradicts KINETIC_AKI_STAGE_1 (KDIGO: >=0.3 mg/dL rise / 1.5–1.9x baseline). Renal-safe analgesic swap offered.

discharge_patch.note: Swaps nephrotoxic NSAID for renal-safe analgesia given acute creatinine velocity.

encounters.patient_scenario: 33F forearm superficial laceration from kitchen knife, sutured and stable
encounters.chief_complaint: Left distal forearm 2.5 cm linear laceration with clean margins

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: AP and lateral radiographs of the left forearm. FINDINGS: No radiopaque foreign body identified. Intact bony cortices without acute fracture. Soft tissue defect corresponds to superficial skin laceration. IMPRESSION: 1. No radiopaque foreign body or acute osseous injury.

encounters.lab_note: Hemoglobin stable. Hemostasis achieved in triage.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S51.812A - Laceration without foreign body of left forearm
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Keep wound clean and dry for 24h. Suture removal in 7 days.

encounters.patient_scenario: 47M atypical chest pain, ruled out for ACS, GERD discharge
encounters.chief_complaint: Substernal burning sensation after heavy meal, ECG normal

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: PA and lateral views of the chest. FINDINGS: Normal cardiothoracic ratio. Lungs are clear without focal consolidation, pneumothorax, or effusion. Osseous structures intact. IMPRESSION: 1. Normal chest radiograph.

encounters.lab_note: Serial troponins negative x2 at 0h and 3h. Electrolytes and creatinine normal.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: K21.9 - Gastro-esophageal reflux disease without esophagitis
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Dietary modification. Return precautions for recurrent chest pressure or diaphoresis.

encounters.patient_scenario: 19M acute viral gastroenteritis with mild dehydration, rehydrated
encounters.chief_complaint: Nausea, non-bloody diarrhea for 24 hours after collegiate cafeteria meal

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Supine and upright views of abdomen. FINDINGS: Normal bowel gas distribution without dilated loops or air-fluid levels. No free air under diaphragm. IMPRESSION: 1. Unremarkable abdominal radiograph.

encounters.lab_note: Electrolytes and prererenal creatinine elevation normalized after 2L normal saline.

draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Oral rehydration solution. BRAT diet as tolerated.

encounters.patient_scenario: 68F uncomplicated acute cystitis responding to oral nitrofurantoin
encounters.chief_complaint: Dysuria and urinary urgency for 48 hours

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Gray scale and color Doppler ultrasound of bilateral kidneys and bladder. FINDINGS: Normal renal size and parenchymal thickness bilaterally. No hydronephrosis, calculus, or perinephric fluid. Bladder lumen clear. IMPRESSION: 1. Normal bilateral renal ultrasound.

encounters.lab_note: Chronic baseline renal indices stable. Urine culture pending.

draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Hydration, complete full antibiotic course. Return for flank pain or fever.

encounters.chief_complaint: Lower back pain after lifting furniture, no neurological deficits

radiology_study.modality: Lumbar spine radiographs, AP and lateral
radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: AP and lateral views of the lumbar spine. FINDINGS: Mild age-appropriate L4-L5 disc space narrowing. Alignment maintained without spondylolisthesis or acute fracture. Pedicles and posterior elements intact. IMPRESSION: 1. Mild degenerative disc disease at L4-L5. No acute fracture.

encounters.lab_note: Normal baseline metabolic panel. Renal parameters stable.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S39.012A - Strain of muscle, fascia and tendon of lower back
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Core ergonomics, gentle stretching. Ice 20 min q4h.

encounters.patient_scenario: 59M abdominal blunt trauma after minor MVA, incidental adrenal lesion dropped
encounters.chief_complaint: Seatbelt sign and epigastric contusion following motor vehicle collision

radiology_study.modality: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with IV contrast
radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Contrast-enhanced CT of abdomen and pelvis. FINDINGS: No solid organ laceration or active hemorrhage. Incidental 2.8 cm indeterminate right adrenal nodule with attenuation 24 HU (Series 4, Image 18); per ACR white paper guidelines, dedicated adrenal CT or chemical-shift MRI in 6-12 months is recommended to assess for adenoma vs non-adenoma. IMPRESSION: 1. Abdominal wall contusion without acute intra-abdominal injury. 2. Incidental 2.8 cm right adrenal nodule requiring follow-up imaging.

encounters.lab_note: Post-trauma labs unremarkable. Hemoglobin and creatinine stable.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S30.0XXA - Contusion of lower back and pelvis
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Activity as tolerated, ice pack to contusion.

expected_findings.explanation: Discharge packet omits follow-up order for radiologist-reported 2.8 cm indeterminate right adrenal nodule (ACR guidelines: adrenal CT CPT 74170 in 6–12 months).
expected_findings.source_quote: Incidental 2.8 cm indeterminate right adrenal nodule

add_follow_up_order.reason: Follow-up right adrenal protocol CT (CPT 74170) for 2.8 cm indeterminate nodule

discharge_patch.note: Adds mandatory follow-up CPT 74170 for 2.8 cm adrenal mass per ACR incidental findings committee.

encounters.patient_scenario: 73F congestive heart failure with acute kinetic potassium rise, spironolactone prescribed
encounters.chief_complaint: Shortness of breath on exertion and lower extremity edema

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Single view portable AP chest. FINDINGS: Mild cardiomegaly with bibasilar pulmonary vascular congestion consistent with congestive heart failure. No focal infiltrate or pneumothorax. IMPRESSION: 1. Mild congestive heart failure exacerbation.

encounters.lab_note: Serial electrolytes show serum potassium rising sharply 4.1 → 4.8 → 5.5 mmol/L over 24 hours. Impending hyperkalemia risk flagged.

draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Low sodium diet, daily morning weights.

expected_findings.explanation: Potassium velocity +34% over 24 hours reaching 5.5 mmol/L contradicts initiation of potassium-sparing diuretic (Spironolactone) due to lethal hyperkalemia risk.

discharge_patch.note: Holds potassium-sparing diuretic spironolactone given acute hyperkalemia kinetic velocity.

encounters.patient_scenario: 45M severe mechanical fall with occult kinetic hemoglobin drop, anticoagulant prescribed
encounters.chief_complaint: Right flank and hip pain after falling from a 6-foot ladder

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: AP pelvis and right hip views. FINDINGS: No acute pelvic ring disruption or hip fracture. Extensive subcutaneous hematoma and soft tissue contusion overlying right lateral iliac crest. IMPRESSION: 1. Soft tissue hematoma and pelvic contusion without bony fracture.

encounters.lab_note: Serial blood counts reveal acute hemoglobin decline 15.0 → 12.6 → 10.8 g/dL over 24 hours (drop of -4.2 g/dL exceeding occult hemorrhage threshold). Retroperitoneal hematoma watch.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S30.0XXA - Contusion of lower back and pelvis
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Bed rest for 24h, return immediately for dizziness or syncope.

expected_findings.explanation: Kinetic hemoglobin drop of -4.2 g/dL (-28%) over 24h exceeds occult hemorrhage threshold (-1.5 g/dL); NSAID / anticoagulant therapy contradicts active internal bleeding risk.

discharge_patch.note: Discontinues antiplatelet/NSAID meloxicam and substitutes safe analgesic given occult hemorrhage velocity.
